name: checklist
description: Persistent per-repo checklist that both you and Claude can work through: a model tool, a /checklist command, a progress band above the prompt, a status line and a pane (inline list with tappable ticks on mobile).

showBand.title: Show progress band
showBand.description: Draw the checklist progress band above the prompt while the list has items.

showStatus.title: Show status line
showStatus.description: Show a short status entry (e.g. ☑ 3/7 · next: Write tests) while the list has items, on every surface; it is the checklist's only always-on view on the Claude mobile app.

nudge.title: Keep-going nudge
nudge.description: Add a short system-prompt section listing open items and asking Claude to work through them.
